messages:
Asha (Sales): Hi team — Hummingbird just approved a short POC. They want a performance baseline (text-gen) before we push pricing. Goals: smoke at 25 qps, sustained at 150 qps for 30m, and microbursts up to 1k qps for 20s. 128-token responses, 2x prompt tokens. 99th p95 targets: 200ms / 120ms respectively. Can we confirm a runbook and cost ballpark?

Jules (Solutions): Copy. Quick questions: which model family are they testing (Llama-variant / mixed-quant)? Any encryption/KMS needs? Also do they require multi-az failover or single-region only?

Asha (Sales): They're planning to use an open 7B Llama-variant (float16), prefer Hosted for speed but will consider Dedicated if price matters. They asked about KMS + audit logs for compliance, but not strict HSM. Single-region (us-west) to start.

Marco (SRE): Ok. Proposed approach: 1) smoke (25 qps) to validate correctness, 2) warm-up + autoscale validation at 150 qps sustained for 30m, 3) burst test with ramp to 1k qps over 10s hold 20s, observe tail latencies and dropped requests. Prewarm with KV caching enabled and a short 5-10m soak.

Sam (Eng-ML): For 128 tokens default, recommend batching window 10-15ms and dynamic batching by route. Use quantized variant if they want cost cut — expect ~1.6x throughput improvement on q4_0. Also suggest prefix caching for repeated prompts.

Jules (Solutions): Runbook draft attached (we'll paste below). Need an ops contact and a data-plane endpoint to hit. Also we should provide a cost estimate: Hosted peak compute + tokens + egress.

Ira (Security): Quick sec checklist: KMS for key encryption at rest, VPC peering or Private deployment for sensitive data, SOC2 / ISO attestation copy, and audit-log retention requirement. Hummingbird asked about key rotation cadence. We should ask them to confirm retention window.

Marco (SRE): Cost sketch (very rough): smoke + warmup + burst over 2 hours on Hosted using standard 7B -> ~ $700-1200 in infra spend (gpu hours + tokens). If they want Dedicated reserved monthly commit that's a separate contract — ping sales for numbers.

Asha (Sales): Good — can we tighten that to an SLA-friendly quote for procurement? They want to see a number < $2k for the whole run to present to finance.

Jules (Solutions): We'll optimize run to hit their asks under $2k: shorter soak (30m sustain -> 20m), use q4_0 quant variant, and reduce burst hold to 15s. Need signoff from Eng-ML on impact to 99th latency.

Sam (Eng-ML): I think with those changes we can likely meet the latency SLOs on Hosted. I'll run a micro-sim on our internal harness and post numbers by EOD. Sample command we plan to run (vegeta):

```
echo 'GET /v1/generate' | vegeta attack -rate=150 -duration=20m -body=request.json | vegeta report
```

Replace with burst profile: `-rate=1000 -duration=15s` for the microburst stage.

Marco (SRE): Also adding a deploy bot note — OpsBot will create a temporary dedicated pool for this POC with autoscale caps and telemetry forwarding to the POC dashboard.

OpsBot: Temporary pool created: pool-id pcp-1717654329, region us-west-2, max-instances 8. Logs forwarded to POC dashboard: /dash/pcp-1717654329. :rocket:

Ira (Security): I'll prepare a one-page sec summary (KMS, TLS, audit) and attach requested SOC2 snapshot. Asha, ask Hummingbird about retention window and whether they need private network.

Asha (Sales): Will do. Next steps: Sam posts micro-sim numbers by EOD, Jules updates runbook and finalizes cost to meet <$2k, Ira sends sec one-pager. I'll schedule the POC kickoff for tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Jules (Solutions): Sounds good. I'll also include a short checklist for prewarm keys, endpoint allowlist, and test prompt set.

Sam (Eng-ML): Posting internal micro-sim numbers now — 150 qps sustained (128 tok) => median 48ms, p95 110ms, p99 190ms on q4_0 with batching=12. Will paste CSV in case notes.

Asha (Sales): Perfect, that's within their SLO. I'll confirm pricing and kickoff. Thanks all! :tada:
